Open the pull request against dollspace-gay/Thermite. Branch from an upstream ref rather than the fork's main, so the process layer stays out of the diff. One PR per RFC, one commit per RFC so the revision derives from git, and never squash-merge an RFC PR or the review history collapses.

```day-atom
{"in":["trust-statement","design-doc"],"out":["upstream-pr"],"next":[]}
```
